description: The Linux application identity moved from /proc/<pid>/comm to the WM class (X11) or app_id (Wayland), with comm as the fallback only (ADD-3, decided by the maintainer on 2026-11-11). `aliases` maps a lowercase comm name, as the X11 driver reported it before (cut by the kernel to 15 bytes), to the lowercase WM class the same application reports now; linux/infra/app_identity_migration.lua converts saved exclusion lists through it once, then writes `marker` to storage.json. Projected into _shared/apps/engine/linux_app_identities_data.lua by tools/codegen/codegen-secure-apps.cjs. `same` lists comm names whose WM class is the same name, so the migration neither changes nor reports them. Any other entry is kept unchanged and logged.
